description: This file defines the Java API wrapper for Spark Streaming's DStream, specifically the JavaDStreamLike trait and its abstract implementation, providing methods for common streaming operations such as map, flatMap, reduce, windowed operations, and transformations with Java functional interfaces.

classes.name: AbstractJavaDStreamLike
classes.description: An abstract class providing a base implementation for JavaDStreamLike, handling common functionality for Java DStream wrappers.

methods.name: print
methods.description: Prints the first ten elements of each RDD in the DStream.

methods.name: print
methods.description: Prints the first 'num' elements of each RDD in the DStream.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns a new DStream with each RDD containing the count of elements.

methods.name: countByValue
methods.description: Returns a new DStream with counts of each distinct value.

methods.name: countByValue
methods.description: Returns a new DStream with counts of each distinct value, with specified number of partitions.

methods.name: countByWindow
methods.description: Counts elements over a sliding window.

methods.name: countByValueAndWindow
methods.description: Counts distinct elements over a sliding window.

methods.name: countByValueAndWindow
methods.description: Counts distinct elements over a sliding window with specified partitions.

methods.name: glom
methods.description: Coalesces elements within each partition into arrays.

methods.name: context
methods.description: Returns the StreamingContext associated with this DStream.

methods.name: map
methods.description: Applies a function to all elements of the DStream.

methods.name: mapToPair
methods.description: Applies a function to all elements to produce key-value pairs.

methods.name: flatMap
methods.description: Applies a function to all elements and flattens the results.

methods.name: flatMapToPair
methods.description: Applies a function to all elements to produce key-value pairs and flattens.

methods.name: mapPartitions
methods.description: Applies a function to each partition of the RDDs.

methods.name: mapPartitionsToPair
methods.description: Applies a function to each partition to produce key-value pairs.

methods.name: reduce
methods.description: Reduces elements in each RDD to a single element.

methods.name: reduceByWindow
methods.description: Reduces elements over a sliding window with a specified function.

methods.name: reduceByWindow
methods.description: Reduces elements over a sliding window with incremental inverse reduce.

methods.name: slice
methods.description: Returns RDDs between specified times.

methods.name: foreachRDD
methods.description: Applies a function to each RDD, registering as output.

methods.name: transform
methods.description: Transforms each RDD with a function.

methods.name: transform
methods.description: Transforms each RDD with a function that also takes the timestamp.

methods.name: transformToPair
methods.description: Transforms each RDD into key-value pairs.

methods.name: transformToPair
methods.description: Transforms each RDD into key-value pairs with timestamp.

methods.name: transformWith
methods.description: Transforms each RDD with another DStream and a function.

methods.name: transformWithToPair
methods.description: Transforms each RDD with another DStream into key-value pairs.

methods.name: transformWith
methods.description: Transforms each RDD with another pair DStream and a function.

methods.name: transformWithToPair
methods.description: Transforms each RDD with another pair DStream into key-value pairs.

methods.name: transformWith
methods.description: Transforms each RDD with another pair DStream into key-value pairs with different key-value types.

methods.name: checkpoint
methods.description: Enables periodic checkpointing of RDDs.
